citation: Zhang Z-Y, Mercado R, Le TT, Zhang C. Unlocking the Chemical Space for Rechargeable Batteries with Generative Solvent Design System. ACS Nano 2026;20:20714-20729. doi:10.1021/acsnano.6c06255

notes.dielectric_constant: deliberately absent. It is reached from the dipole through the LF-MLR-DC-200 piecewise regression, whose fitted coefficients are published only as a raster figure (SI figure S15), so no dc column can be written without fabricating one.
notes.dipole: the norm of the DFT dipole 3-vector for the single conformer whose coordinates the source file carries, NOT the three-lowest-conformer average the published permittivity chain uses

selection.rule: one row per canonical SMILES, parseable and single-fragment, at most 16 heavy atoms; sorted by canonical SMILES
